mapper.select: SELECT companion_id AS id, trip_id, name, friend_member_id, sort_no, share_amount FROM trip_companion WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY sort_no, companion_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_companion (trip_id, name, friend_member_id, sort_no) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{name}, #{friendMemberId}, #{sortNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_companion SET name = #{name} WHERE companion_id = #{companionId} AND trip_id = #{tripId}
UPDATE trip_companion SET share_amount = #{amount} WHERE companion_id = #{companionId} AND trip_id = #{tripId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_companion WHERE companion_id = #{companionId} AND trip_id = #{tripId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payer = #{newName} WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND payer = #{oldName}
